facts.fact: HISP Rwanda says clinical data collected in the e-SENI hospital EMR is automatically structured and integrated into national health information systems, including DHIS2-powered platforms, with a central EMR server synchronising data from facilities.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with HISP Rwanda and the Susan Buffett Foundation

note: as_of is the published date, the document gives no event date. The patient unique identification is facility-level; no national identifier is stated.
